name: NH Collection Madrid Paseo del Prado
description: NH Collection Madrid Paseo del Prado is situated in the heart of Madrid's art triangle, across the street from the Prado, Reina Sofía and Thyssen museums. Shop at the nearby designer boutiques and exclusive cafés in the Salamanca district and Calle Serrano or stroll through Retiro Park. For links to the rest of the city and the airport, Banco de España and Atocha stations are minutes away. NH Collection Madrid Paseo del Prado is set in a historic Neo-Baroque palace with some of the rooms overlooking the famous Neptuno fountain. Designed in relaxed, neutral colors, rooms are enriched with handmade carpets from the Real Fábrica de Tapices and beautiful paintings adorn the walls. For modern comforts, guests enjoy free Wi-Fi, as well as tea and coffee making facilities. Connecting rooms are available. A fresh breakfast buffet is served daily and offers a delicious variety of hot and cold dishes. In the afternoon and evening, delight in tapas creations by Paco Roncero, a Michelin-starred chef. The Estado Puro tapas bar offers a wide selection of wines and al fresco seating. Our tea room offers a unique Suite & Tea service with a surprising collection of teas and sweet as well as savory snacks. To invigorate your body, make use of our rooftop gym and enjoy spectacular views of Madrid during your workout.
